## Failing tests

- TestRateLimitFallsBackToTheNextRow: the first row's round exits rate_limited; a new role record starts on the second row in the same state; the run keeps both records.
- TestErrorExitFallsBackToTheNextRow: a round that exits with class `error` (not auth) falls back the same way (adj 156, vendor.fallback-trigger-v2, which supersedes 114).
- TestAuthAndUnclassifiedExitsStillStopTheSlice: an `auth` exit and an `unclassified` exit stop the slice with the reason even when a next row exists. A successful exit that carries permission denials still proceeds (design.md:307 and :456; the existing TestASuccessfulPermissionDenialProceeds stays unchanged; owner 2026-10-23). The existing TestAnExitNotClassifiedOkStopsTheSliceWithTheReason (internal/engine/stop_test.go:14) keeps its meaning with the new class.
- TestClaudeAndCodexRunnersMapUnclassifiedToTheUnclassifiedClass: internal/daemon/runner.go maps the adapters' unclassified class to engine.ExitUnclassified, not ExitError; denied stays a stop.
- TestFallbackIsSticky: after a fallback, the same role's next round starts on the fallback row, with no new run.json field (decision 115).
- TestResumeOnlyWithTheSameVendorAndModel: latestSession (internal/engine/round.go:44) skips a session from another vendor or model.
- TestFallbackOnTheLastRowStopsWithTheReasons: when the last row also exits rate_limited or error, the slice stops, and Reason names the exit of each row.
- TestRunPlanKeepsEveryRowWithAnAdapter: the plan keeps the lineup list in order (internal/daemon/runs.go:224-231).
- S83 follow-up: once the plan keeps every row, the Waves lineup editor's left/right cycling (internal/tui/lineup.go) reaches the matrix alternatives. Add a check for it here.
